changelog: Fixes the control page's auto-reload after a Factory Reset reboot, which never actually worked in v0.15.2: reconnection events ("reconnect") are emitted by socket.io's Manager, not the Socket instance, so the listener needed to be socket.io.on(...) rather than socket.on(...) - the previous code silently never fired at all, leaving the page stuck on stale "success" text and disabled buttons after every factory reset until manually refreshed. Also includes all v0.15.3 changes (Factory Reset PermissionError fix for read-only labwc config files, broader exception handling in the updater).
